# Sav PDF Viewer

> A fast, private, open-source PDF reader for Android.

Sav PDF Viewer is a paid Android app (€2.49 on Google Play) that opens and reads PDF files. It is built and maintained by Saverio Morelli, an independent developer. The app is licensed under GPL-3.0 and written in Kotlin.

## Key facts

- Platform: Android only (not available on iOS, macOS, Windows, or Linux)
- Price: €2.49 on Google Play
- License: GPL-3.0 (open source)
- Developer: Saverio Morelli
- Language: Kotlin
- Permissions: none required
- Data collection: none — no analytics, no tracking, no telemetry
- Category: PDF viewer (not an editor)

## What it does

- Opens and reads PDF files quickly
- Search text within PDFs
- Select and copy text
- Bookmarks for favourite pages
- Resume reading from where you left off
- Open password-protected PDFs
- Night mode for comfortable reading
- Share PDFs with contacts
- Open links within documents
- Customisable: scroll direction, zoom level, and more

## What it does NOT do

- It does not edit PDFs
- It does not collect any user data
- It does not require any permissions
- It does not depend on Google, Huawei, or any third-party service

## Where to get it

- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.saverio.pdfviewer (recommended, latest version)
- GitHub: https://github.com/Sav22999/sav-pdf-viewer-pro (source code and releases)
- Amazon AppStore and Huawei AppGallery versions are obsolete and may not receive updates
